description_text:
A blend model of a connective tissue with all its elements neatly labelled. The elements are namely collagen, elastin, reticulin and some cell elements. Both procedural and image textures have been used on non overlapping UVs.The formats 3mf, ply, obj, fbx, USDZ,GLTZ & GLB with applied uv mapped textures have also been included in the downloads along with  stl.
I have included the various formats needed by various customer for the various 3d modelling softwares they may be using. The following formats are compressed in rar formats :-

  -  blend

  -  3mf

  -  stl

  -  obj

  -  fbx

  -  glb

  -  gltz

  -  usdzThe downloaded files have to unpacked using any rar unpacker. After unpacking, the folder content of the respective formats will be as follows :-.

  -  blend :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  3mf :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  stl :- single file with only geometry data

  -  obj :- mutiple files including .obj,.mtl, images textures.

  -  fbx :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  glb :- single file with all applied and packed textures.

  -  gltz :- mutiple files including .bin, images textures.

  -  usdz :- single file 

The native file is blend so the open source software blender opens mostly all the files, with textures (packed with the files). The best way is to open the files named blend with blender. Other files have to be imported in blender by clicking within blender File >>Import>>select the type of file you want to import>>open file location of the downloaded unzipped files>>select the file>>the model would open in the 3d viewport of the software.The other files including blender can be opened with most of the free and paid 3d modelling software. The files obj & fbx are compatible with other 3d modeling software, example maya. These software's have the open/import options similar to blender. The files stl and 3mf are compatible with 3d printing software's. The built in3d builder " windows software opens all of these files including glb, & gltz. In case you don't have 3d builder installed just download it free from Microsoft store for free. For 3d builder 3mf, fbx, stl, glb are standalone files (right click the model file>>select open with>>3d builder). For obj,ply, & gltz 3d builder will prompt you to select the model files .mtl and image textures (these are packed in the rar files).The textures files have been separately supplied additionally; in case one needs them.

description_text:
the brainstem (or brain stem) is the posterior part of the brain, continuous with the spinal cord. In the human brain the brainstem includes the midbrain, the pons and medulla oblongata of the hindbrain. The midbrain continues with the thalamus of the diencephalon through the tentorial notch,[1] and sometimes the diencephalon is included in the brainstem.[2]
The brainstem is a very small component of the brain, making up only around 2.6 per cent of the total weight of the brain.[3] It is though, a crucial part of the brain providing the main motor and sensory nerve supply to the face and neck via the cranial nerves. Ten pairs of cranial nerves come from the brainstem. It is also of prime importance in the conveyance of motor and sensory pathways from the rest of the brain to the body, and from the body back to the brain. These pathways include the corticospinal tract (motor), the dorsal column-medial lemniscus pathway (fine touch, vibration sensation, and proprioception), and the spinothalamic tract (pain, temperature, itch, and crude touch).

Knee Joint Model Unbent State for 3D Print is a three-dimensional model of human knee bones set that is a part of people skeleton framework bones structure, and that is a largest and complex joint in the human body.
The knee joint is a hinge-type synovial joint connecting the femur (thigh bone) to the tibia (shin bone). It includes the patella (kneecap) and is stabilized by ligaments such as the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments (ACL and PCL), and the medial and lateral collateral ligaments (MCL and LCL). The menisci, two crescent-shaped cartilage discs, cushion and support the joint, aiding in shock absorption and stability during movement. description_text:
KEY HIGHLIGHTS  
The pack includes 190 models of viruses, bacteria, protozoa, blood cells, and spores. It also contains 38 animations. All models are optimized and have a limited number of materials and textures.      
KEY FEATURES
  - 
Over 190 Assets. The pack includes the main categories of microorganisms — viruses, bacteria, protozoa, blood cells, and spores.
The models are anatomically accurate and can be used both for games and medical projects. All objects include the necessary animations.

  - 
Animation.  All models include 3 to 5 animations, such as Floating, Moving, Twisting, Idle, Walking, Running, and Jumping.

  - 
Ease of Use. The pack includes two files with different Unity versions, and in each one, the scene is set up in three render pipelines. Simply download the version you need and open the scene in your preferred render pipeline. Everything is clear and easy to use.

  - 
Optimized Models. Lightweight meshes, few textures, and simple shaders ensure smooth performance on mobile, VR/AR, PC, and consoles while keeping visuals high-quality.

  - 
Support. Free updates and technical support available in our Discord (https://discord.gg/ithappy).

We recommend using together:
Medical Pack – https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/science/medical/medical-pack-c4fe78a3-eeea-48b5-ae01-e2e6c9e5785e
Sci-Fi Props – https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/exterior/sci-fi-exterior/sci-fi-props-910a8e1b-47ab-42d4-aa6d-29ad8c35e9fe     
190 Unique AssetsEach model has a high enough level of detail for use in VR projects and first-person games, and anatomical accuracy suitable for medical and educational applications.     
All assets include 3–4 color variations, allowing for flexible visual customization.     
Viruses
Coronavirus — spherical shape with protein spikes.
Adenovirus — icosahedral capsid structure.
Retrovirus — spherical body with surface receptors.
Bacteriophage T4 — virus with hexagonal head and leg-like base, infecting bacteria.
Influenza virus — round particle with surface glycoproteins.
Ebola virus — filamentous, thread-like shape.
Tobacco mosaic virus (TMV) — cylindrical viral structure, one of the first discovered viruses.    
Bacteria
Staphylococcus — clustered spherical bacteria.
Streptococcus — chains of round bacterial cells.
Bacillus — rod-shaped bacterium.
Clostridium — spore-forming bacteria with swollen ends.
Escherichia coli (E. coli) — typical rod-shaped bacterium with flagella.
Vibrio cholerae — curved bacteria with a single flagellum.
Spirochaeta — long spiral-shaped bacteria with corkscrew motion.
Streptomyces — filamentous, branching bacteria similar to fungi.     
Protozoa and Microorganisms
Amoeba proteus — shape-changing organism with pseudopodia.
Euglena — flagellated unicellular organism with an eyespot.
Paramecium — oval cell covered with tiny cilia.
Permatozoon — specialized motile cell with a long tail.
Trypanosoma — parasitic flagellated protozoan.
Cyst — dormant stage of a microorganism enclosed in a protective wall.      
Spores and Fungal Forms
Bacterial spores — dense, resistant rounded structures.
Fungal spores — spherical or spiky particles resembling pollen.
Mycelium fragments — branching filamentous fungal structures.     
Blood Cells
Red blood cells (Erythrocytes) — biconcave, nucleus-free discs.
White blood cells (Leukocytes) — irregular immune cells with nuclei.
Platelets — small cell fragments involved in clotting.     
Nanostructures and Fictional Microorganisms
Nanobots — futuristic robotic microstructures inspired by viral forms.
Synthetic cells — bio-mechanical organisms with metallic elements.
Mutant forms — stylized, fictional variations of real microorganisms.     
FILES
You’ll be able to download formats such as Unity Package, UE, Blender, C4D, Maya, 3DSMax, FBX, OBJ, GLTF, and STL.       
COMPATIBILITY    

  - Blender 3.6+

  - Unity 2021.3+

  - Unity 6000+

  - Unreal Engine 4.20+

  - Unreal Engine 5.0+

  - Godot Engine 3.4+

  - Roblox

TECHNICAL INFO
  - 
Geometry:     

  - 192 Unique Assets

  - 330k triangles all pack

  - Materials: All models use 4 materials        

  - Textures: All models use 1 texture.        

SUPPORTFree updates and technical support: https://discord.com/invite/jxrQM8hXnd     
We would love to hear from you: support@ithappystudios.com
We aim to respond within 24 hours.      
Leave a review to help us improve and expand this character pack further! Your projects are the reason we create 3D models. We genuinely care about how you use our work, and we'd love to hear your thoughts on the pack.      
FOLLOW USNew packs coming out, updates, promotions, tutorials:
DISCORD - https://discord.com/invite/jxrQM8hXnd
YOUTUBE - https://www.youtube.com/@ithappystudios

The model features all major regions of the vertebral column, including the cervical, thoracic, and lumbar vertebrae, ending with the sacrum and coccyx. It includes realistic intervertebral discs and bone textures, making it ideal for orthopedic visualizations, chiropractic education, and medical animations.
Key Features:
Full Anatomy: Complete vertebral column from C1 (Atlas) to the Coccyx.
Structural Detail: Includes accurately shaped vertebral bodies, spinous processes, and fibrocartilaginous discs.
Realistic Textures: High-resolution PBR bone textures with subtle pitting and organic variations.
Clean Topology: Optimized for high-end rendering and medical simulation.
Technical Specifications:
Regions Included: Cervical, Thoracic, Lumbar, Sacrum, and Coccyx.
Maps: Diffuse, Normal, and Roughness maps included.
